_note: MixShift contract-class incident, appended per the append protocol: a figure's unit must describe the value it labels. Every other rule here checks a RELATIONSHIP -- claims against figures, bases against each other, caveats against quotation sites -- so a wrong unit passed every gate and shipped. Two instances, one per UNIT-2 predicate. (1) ads.ad_driven_sales.p2 is dollars the analysis engine served as 'currency' (served_unit), relabelled 'ratio' somewhere downstream, so the page printed '2244820.0%' for $22.4K. (2) ads.acos.p2 carries no served contract at all -- the pre-0.2.0 path the first predicate cannot reach -- and stores an already-whole 45 under 'ratio', which multiplies by 100 on the way to the page and prints '4500.0%' for a 45% ACoS. Both figures are otherwise clean: source paths resolve, bases are consistent, no claim quotes them wrongly.

claims.text: Ad-attributed sales and ACoS both stand above their prior-period levels.
